description: Ported from Silence-CI-Project ($loggedId): the employee whose email matches the logged user. |user_id| is injected by the session watchdog.

queries.query: SELECT e.* FROM employees e JOIN silence_ci_internal_db.silence_users u ON (u.email = e.email) WHERE u.user_id = |user_id|
